title: DRAFT: Decoding and Reconstructing 3D Room Layouts from fMRI and Camera Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2610.31108v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) decoders reconstruct images and 3D objects, recovering the metric geometry of rooms from a moving viewpoint remains an open challenge. We introduce, to our knowledge for the first time, the task of reconstructing 3D layouts of held-out scenes using only the known camera trajectories and the fMRI signals of participants watching indoor walkthroughs, without any visual frames. The task is hard because of the temporal mismatch between rapid visual changes and blurred fMRI signals. Our method, DRAFT (Decoding and Reconstructing 3D room lAyouts from fMRI and Trajectories), extracts a compact layout representation from the early visual cortex and fuses this neural code with the geometric free space derived from camera motion. To evaluate it, we propose layout r, the Pearson correlation between predicted and ray-cast log depths. On ten held-out scenes (20 participants), DRAFT reaches a layout

translated_title: DRAFT：从fMRI和相机轨迹解码并重建3D房间布局
translated_abstract: 尽管功能性磁共振成像解码器已经能够重建图像和3D物体，但从移动视角恢复房间的度量几何仍然是一个开放的挑战。据我们所知，我们首次提出了这样一个任务：仅使用已知的相机轨迹和观看室内漫游视频的被试的fMRI信号来重建未见过的场景的3D布局，而不使用任何视觉帧。这项任务非常困难，因为快速的视觉变化与模糊的fMRI信号之间存在时间上的失配。我们的方法DRAFT（从fMRI和轨迹解码并重建3D房间布局）从早期视觉皮层提取紧凑的布局表示，并将这种神经编码与从相机运动推导出的几何自由空间相融合。为了评估该方法，我们提出了布局r指标，即预测深度与光线投射对数深度之间的皮尔逊相关系数。在十个保留场景（20名被试）上，DRAFT达到了布局……
tldr: 该论文首次提出仅凭相机轨迹和被试的fMRI信号（无需任何视觉帧）重建未见场景的3D房间布局，通过从早期视觉皮层解码紧凑布局表示并与相机运动推导的几何自由空间融合来实现这一目标，同时提出了布局r这一新评估指标。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DRAFT, the first method to reconstruct 3D room layouts of held-out scenes using only camera trajectories and fMRI signals without any visual frames, by decoding a compact layout representation from the early visual cortex and fusing it with geometric free space derived from camera motion, along with a new evaluation metric called layout r.
